verdict.rationale: uv has some documented bulk operations: `uv add -r` adds every dependency from a requirements.txt in one step, and `uv cache clean` clears the whole cache at once. Cargo-style workspaces suggest it can manage many packages together, but the evidence shows no concrete bulk command run across a workspace. Most other documented commands, such as `--upgrade-package` and `uv tool install`, work on one item at a time. Missing for 10: an evidenced upgrade-all or bulk tool-upgrade command, documented batch operations across workspace members, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
